description: The GOP-controlled New Hampshire House passed its state budget, including HB 2, despite criticism from both House Democrats and Gov. Chris Sununu. NH Journal reports House Majority Leader Jason Osborne emphasized the package delivered a tax cut for every person in New Hampshire.
